title: The Late Interior
author: Lior Sterling
blurb: Silas Thornbury, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
